metadata.description: pablolok's Claude Code skills — one plugin per skill.

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: Track a project's work in BACKLOG.md with doc folders archived on close; ships the doc gates and a two-way GitHub Issues mirror.

plugins.name: pre-implementation-review
plugins.description: Before writing code, decide the right design — responsibilities, the pattern for each, ownership and seams, what is stored only if it can't be derived; reuse and low duplication follow from it.

plugins.name: review-backlog
plugins.description: Periodic review of the backlog: run the document gates, clean up what has rotted, close with ONE proposal of what to do next.

plugins.name: skill-retrospective
plugins.description: When a piece of work closes, rewrite the skills it used in place with what it taught; two hooks log the skills used and ask for the retrospective.
